high_level_description: This image captures a group of three people taking a selfie in front of the Oculus, a modern architectural structure located at the World Trade Center Transportation Hub in New York City. The setting is outdoors on a clear, sunny day with a bright blue sky. The person on the left is wearing glasses and a patterned shirt with a backpack strap visible over their shoulder. The individual in the middle is dressed in a red outfit with a lanyard around their neck, which has a badge attached to it. The person on the right is wearing a yellow top and also has a lanyard with a badge.
